requirements.requirement_text: The proposed project manager must hold a current professional engineering license.
Resumes of additional installation technicians may be included to support the bid.
The proposed air-cooled chiller must have a COP of at least 5.8 according to the manufacturer's technical datasheet.
All proposed units must use R-32 refrigerant.
Up to 10 evaluation points will be awarded for documented energy-efficiency improvements beyond the required COP.
The bid package must include a signed compliance declaration form.
Bidders may attach an optional installation schedule for reference.
Additional compliance information should be supplied when considered appropriate by the evaluation committee.
